evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01", a date with no time. POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-01-01"} set a due date on a todo that had none (200). PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed. PATCH /todos/1 with only a title change left dueDate unchanged.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "10/01/2026" and "2026-10-01T10:00:00" each returned 400 {"error":"dueDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format"}. PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-14 (UTC). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the not-done todos with past due dates (2026-10-01 and 2026-01-01). It excluded the todo due today (2026-10-14), the future todo, the todo with no due date, and the done todo with a past due date (2026-09-01). The done todo showed isOverdue false after PATCH done:true.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / shows each todo's due date next to its title: 2026-10-01, 2026-10-14, 2026-12-01, 2026-01-01, 2026-09-01.
evidence.AC6: On the list page, only the two overdue todos (due 2026-10-01 and 2026-01-01) show "überfällig". The todos due today, due in the future, and done with a past date show no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the two overdue todos, past2 and none.
